_meta.source: Diagnostic operator-language seed retained from the pre-redesign baseline; delivery does not branch on its verdict.

entry_schema.pattern: JS RegExp source (matched with the flags in `flags`, default 'iu')

_meta.growth_contract: This is the DAY-ONE seed, NOT a frozen closed set. New tics are added as they surface in live use (same schema). §1.5 = what ships day-one.
_meta.canonical_9_allow_list_note: The canonical-9 standing-crew names are NEVER linted (they are legitimate operator-language). Only TRANSIENT themed-names (the -N-suffixed *-wright etc.) lint. The allow-list is consumed by the transient-themed-name rule, not encoded as match entries.
_meta.enforce_definition: high-confidence diagnostic match; independently materialized delivery never blocks on or delegates repair from this verdict.
_meta.observe_definition: lower-confidence diagnostic match; logged only and never a delivery decision.

out_of_door_exclusions.ruling: Peggy 2026-07-19 — OPTION 2: OUT-OF-DOOR. Ship NO morning-mirror lexicon entry (see PEGGY-MM-RULING.md).
out_of_door_exclusions.rationale: LLM-generated via composer writer-cards; posts via urllib bypassing herald; #6's route per §1.3; guarded at the composer-template self-ban, NOT lint-able by a verbatim door. A verbatim-phrase ban structurally cannot target generated prose — the correct enforcement layer for generated prose is the GENERATOR (the composer-template CONSTRAINT lines that already self-ban praise + jargon at the prompt level).
out_of_door_exclusions.not_banned: the writer-name pool labels + the 2 attribution suffixes are legitimate operator-opted-in content (the operator chose the literary bingo-rotation) — never linted.
out_of_door_exclusions.follow_up: whether the composer self-ban is itself strong is a separate anti-theater concern for a later pass (Commwright flags to Peggy); NOT this build.

shape_rule_modes._note: The MODE (enforce | observe) of each §1.6 shape-rule + the transient-name / concession sub-modes, made DATA-DRIVEN + AUDITABLE here (Sol fix-cycle-2 M5). The computable predicate (regex) stays in shape-rules.ts (a falsifiable proxy can't live in JSON), but its enforce/observe mode is retunable from this seed. shape-rules.ts reads these at compile-time and falls back to the documented default if a key is absent.

shape-c-length-reply.note: operator-addressed reply soft-bound (substantive replies run long)

shape-d-claim-needs-proof.note: claim-word without a same-clause proof token; diagnostic only because honest status summaries can match this proxy.

shape-e-restatement-praise.note: restating the operator's point back as praise

shape-e-concession-standalone.note: standalone concession (no substantive correction) — permanent observe; §20 keeps honest corrections

shape-transient-themed-name.note: whole-body transient *-wright/registry themed-name; opening occurrence enforces via shape-a
